title: DMP message
description: A stored message: the sixteen fields of section 4.1, and the two fields Appendix F defines. Informative: byte limits and the one-line rule are left to section 4.5.

data.description: Gate data (gate-data.schema.json), private data or a marker.

origin.description: Appendix F: the replica that created a message received from another host. A host that does not implement Appendix F never emits it.

hlc.description: Appendix F: the origin's hybrid clock when it sent the message, as `<ms>.<counter>.<replica>`. A host that does not implement Appendix F never emits it.

identifier.description: An identifier (section 1.4). ASCII, so 64 characters are 64 bytes.

address.description: A scheme, a colon and a part of identifiers joined by `/` (section 3.1). The part's form per scheme is not expressed.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC, in the fixed 24-character form (section 1.4).

kind.description: A built-in kind, or a private `x-` kind (section 4.2).

choices.description: The answers a question or handoff offers: 1 to 20 distinct strings.
